info.description: Per-page SEO metadata. Every field is optional — leave blank to inherit the site-wide default from Site Settings.

seoTitle.description: Browser tab + Google result title. Blank = use the site default.

metaDescription.description: Google result snippet. Aim for 150-160 characters.

canonicalUrl.description: Only set this if this page duplicates another URL.

robotsIndex.description: Off = ask Google not to list this page in search results.

robotsFollow.description: Off = ask Google not to follow links on this page.

ogTitle.description: Title shown when shared on social media. Blank = uses SEO Title.

ogDescription.description: Description shown when shared. Blank = uses Meta Description.

schemaType.description: schema.org type, e.g. WebPage, AboutPage, ContactPage, FAQPage.

customJsonLd.description: Advanced: raw JSON-LD. If valid JSON, it fully replaces the auto-generated schema for this page.
